labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a changed Table title type, a new behaviour; feature template requires Discussions approval first.

items.body:
Rich's feature template asks that new features be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal there if you want to pursue this.

An earlier request for the same change, #4171, was closed as not planned, so please read that thread before posting again.

The `title` argument of `Table` is typed `Union[str, Text]` in [rich/table.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py). Combining a `Rule` and a `Table` in a `Table.grid`, as you mention, is the existing way to lay them out together.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
